title: TRICARE Select Stay Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance - Payment Figures
content:
**Calculation.** The TRICARE payment on a **TRICARE Select** inpatient stay reprocessed for other health insurance is figured as follows.

- **Enrollees covered.** It covers the reprocessed stay of an enrollee who is the only member of the sponsor family enrolled in Select, read from the enrollee's own Select enrollment carrying the family's fee billing under an individual fee arrangement, whose Select enrollment took effect in the plan year that contains the adjudication date, and who holds no TRICARE Prime enrollment or exactly one that took effect in that same plan year, so that the family's deductible and catastrophic totals are the enrollee's own and every claim line and every installment whose coverage period has begun on that enrollment, and every Prime claim line and Prime installment of the enrollee, belongs to that calendar plan year; for any other enrollee this calculation settles nothing. A fee-exempt enrollment carries no fee arrangement from which the family's Select membership can be read, so the fee-exempt tiers (the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers) are outside this calculation by design.
- **Covered days.** Every billed inpatient day of a reprocessed stay is covered.
- **Payable allowed amount.** An inpatient mental health stay is priced by the day, so its payable allowed amount is the reversed line's allowed amount times the covered days divided by the billed days, rounded to the cent; any other reprocessed stay is payable at the reversed line's full allowed amount when it has a covered day and not at all otherwise.
- **Amount cost-shared on.** With other health insurance on file, the amount a reprocessed stay is cost-shared on is its payable allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, never below zero; otherwise it is the payable allowed amount.
- **Beneficiary liability.** The beneficiary liability on a reprocessed stay is the tier's network admission copayment, charged once for the stay. A reprocessed stay with no covered day carries no beneficiary liability.
- **TRICARE payment.** TRICARE pays as primary payer on a reprocessed stay: the payable allowed amount less the beneficiary liability, rounded to the cent and never below zero.

Plan years are calendar years of 12 months, reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network admission copayment 201.00)

Acute inpatient admission, 3 days, allowed amount 7200.00, other insurer paid 5000.00: payable allowed amount 7200.00; amount cost-shared on 2200.00; liability 201.00; TRICARE payment 7200.00 less 201.00, that is 6999.00.

Inpatient mental health stay, 8 days billed, allowed amount 6400.00: payable allowed amount 6400.00 times 8 divided by 8, that is 6400.00; liability 201.00; TRICARE payment 6199.00.
